listing.name: Midtown Madness 3 — Midtown Madness 3 — Static Recompilation (taxidriverhk)
listing.summary: Upstream estimates roughly 80%; boots, movies, loading screens and full Paris/Washington races with audio/gamepad at about 40–50 FPS and 2x internal resolution; ten-minute sessions claimed. New supersampling/FXAA, resizable 4:3 window, cached background shader compilation and rumble forwarding remain upstream claims. Loading/results hitches, occasional missing colour grade, 43 unchecked caller-flag-sensitive functions and unconfirmed physical rumble remain; networking stubbed out. No full progression/completion or Portcove runtime qualification. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Midtown Madness 3 Original Xbox complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 4D53002A; XBE build2003-05-08/XDK5233; SHA1 e63b03dd956544d3838bead8be5622da6cd189e1.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract own retail Xbox disc and run the full regenerate/MSVC pipeline; game data remains needed at runtime.
